user_conditions_audit.claim: D/E positive supervision requires label sources rather than invented targets
user_conditions_audit.reason: Positive supervised state-transition/decision rows need a justified target source. METHOD_ONLY and hard-negative evidence-discipline rows can still be constructed when their targets are mechanically valid, but they do not substitute for positive Hyperposition/GRF transition labels.
user_conditions_audit.training_change: Block positive D/E rows until U_state, D_resolve, U_test_order and f_salience_order are versioned and verified. Use pairwise/listwise ordering for utility/salience instead of fabricated scalar values where calibration is absent.

user_conditions_audit.claim: C1 cheap pretest should decide whether the model size is wrong
user_conditions_audit.reason: C1 is a strong cheap diagnostic, but no movement is underdetermined. Probe methodology has control/causality limitations and SFT failure can arise from prerequisite, supervision consistency, optimization, forgetting, and rare-pattern learning issues. Model size is one hypothesis, not the only conclusion.
user_conditions_audit.training_change: Replace binary size verdict with GO / INVESTIGATE / NO_GO matrix and preregister data, optimization, checkpoint/tokenizer, probe and positive-control checks before size blame.

user_conditions_audit.claim: train mixed capabilities in one run but instrument separate holdouts/probes at checkpoints
user_conditions_audit.reason: Aggregate metrics can hide capability-specific failure and interference. Current Trigger-2 work already argues for separable binder/process metrics; this becomes mandatory across the full Xeno functionality map.
user_conditions_audit.training_change: Capability-vector checkpoint evaluation is mandatory; aggregate score cannot mint pass when any required channel fails.

user_conditions_audit.claim: look for abilities that were not explicitly trained
user_conditions_audit.reason: Emergence testing is useful only if explicit-training overlap, source ancestry, shortcut leakage and holdout reuse are excluded.
user_conditions_audit.training_change: Add EMERGENT_CANDIDATE lifecycle state and require untrained-capability audit on frozen independent evaluation families.

external_method_inputs.use: Probe classifiers need controls and cannot alone establish causal use of decoded information.

external_method_inputs.source: Xue et al. 2026, ACL 2026 long paper 1393, doi:10.18653/v1/2026.acl-long.1393
external_method_inputs.use: SFT non-learning has heterogeneous causes; aggregate gains can mask unlearned subsets.
Dataset versioning/traceability as a first-class lifecycle requirement.

external_method_inputs.source: Hullermeier et al. 2008, Artificial Intelligence 172, doi:10.1016/j.artint.2008.08.002
external_method_inputs.use: Pairwise preference supervision can learn ordering without absolute scalar labels.
Label quality affects both training and evaluation; explicit review/cleaning prioritization is justified.

swarm_review.finding: Trigger-2 must optimize for the complete final Xeno model-side functionality, not for binder/probe success in isolation.
Do not invent positive D/E targets. Rank/order supervision is valid only where the ordering rule itself is specified and deterministic/adjudicated.
C1 probe movement is diagnostic evidence; pair with behavioral/OOD evaluation and controls before causal or scale conclusions.
Content hashes alone prove byte identity but not semantic currency. Add lifecycle, semantic version, dependency and supersession edges.
Every Trigger-2 cycle must rediscover the current artifact inventory and propagate review only through declared changed dependencies.
Mixed full-FT requires checkpoint-separated capability and retention curves; a global score may not hide channel regression.
Admit protocol/versioning delta; no positive Hyperposition/GRF training rows minted because reference labelers remain unspecified.

next_exact_gate: Specify and deterministically test U_state, D_resolve, U_test_order and f_salience_order semantics against current Hyperposition/GRF definitions; then generate versioned positive D/E rows and wire dependency-hash stale propagation before any pre-job freeze.
